h1:
Khon Kaen Cafes
11 Spots for Working & Photos, in Town + Around Khon Kaen University
intro: Khon Kaen is packed with KKU students and freelancers, so cafes have sprouted everywhere — especially in the Kangsadan area behind the university, where you can walk a few steps and find a coffee shop with outlets and WiFi. We picked 11 spots that are actually open right now, split into two groups: ones for long working sessions, and ones for nice photos. For each we tell you the area, rough prices, and opening hours, so you can match the cafe to what you actually came to do.

blocks.html: Khon Kaen's cafes cluster in two main zones: the Kangsadan area behind Khon Kaen University, full of student-priced spots for working, and in town around Si Chan–Chuan Chuen Road and Bueng Kaen Nakhon, where cafes go all out on decor for photos. We've ordered the list by purpose, not just by how good the coffee is — because a place with great coffee but cramped seating and a place with comfy seats and outlets at every table suit completely different people.

blocks.text: Work-Friendly Cafes Around Khon Kaen University (Kangsadan)

blocks.html: These are the spots where you can genuinely sit for hours — outlets, WiFi, and seating that fits a laptop. Most are in the Kangsadan area behind KKU, a few minutes' walk or drive from campus. Coffee starts around 50–90 THB, which is friendly on a student budget.

items.name: Caffeingest
items.blurb: A cafe on the ground floor of a condo in Kangsadan, with a warm look from wood and plants and natural light all day. Reviewers mention it often as a place you can genuinely sit and work or read for hours. It has outlets and free WiFi, and it's fairly quiet because it sits in a private corner — good for anyone who wants to focus on work for a long stretch.

items.name: inch & ounce
items.blurb: A two-floor minimalist cafe near Mittraphap Road, about 100 meters past Ratchaphruek Hospital. The space is wide and airy, with outlets spread throughout and WiFi. The drink and cake menu is big, with cups running 60–90 THB. It's a favorite among people who work because the seating is comfortable and never cramped.
items.meta: Near Mittraphap Rd, past Ratchaphruek Hospital · From ฿60–90

items.name: Sri Brown Cafe
items.blurb: A leafy garden cafe in Kangsadan near KKU, with both a two-floor air-conditioned indoor section and an outdoor garden zone. There's plenty of seating for solo workers and groups alike, and prices are fair for the quality. Students and workers use it regularly as a study spot.
items.meta: Adunyaram Rd, Kangsadan · Open 7:00–23:00 · Mid-range prices

items.name: GOODBEANS Roastery
items.blurb: A roastery and specialty cafe in Kangsadan, seriously put together across a two-floor indoor section and an outdoor garden with a koi pond. Coffee is the draw here since they roast their own beans, so it's worth a stop if you want a good cup. There are outlets for working, and prices start around 90 THB — a touch higher than the usual student spots, but you get the bean quality.
items.meta: Tawan Mai Rd, Kangsadan · Open 7:30–22:30 · From ฿90

items.name: Loading Matcha Cafe
items.blurb: A minimalist specialty matcha cafe in Kangsadan with a calm, quiet feel and a cat to play with on the second floor. It has outlets and WiFi and stays open until midnight, so it suits people who like working late and matcha fans who want a place that takes its green-tea drinks seriously. Prices start around 75 THB.

items.name: JuneKo.house
items.blurb: A cafe inside the Khon Kaen University grounds — wide, open, and bright, good for groups studying or having a team meeting. Drinks run 45–65 THB, the cheapest in this group, and it's open until 22:00. It's where students meet up since it's on campus and you don't have to go anywhere.

blocks.title: Tip
blocks.html: During midterms and finals, the cafes in Kangsadan get very crowded from afternoon into the night. If you're planning a long work session, come in the morning before 11am to grab a table near an outlet more easily. Late-opening spots like Loading Matcha and Moooo are good options if you want to sit after the others close.

blocks.text: Photogenic Cafes In Town + Around the Lake

blocks.html: This group leans more toward atmosphere and photo angles than long work sessions. Many are in town around Si Chan–Chuan Chuen Road and Bueng Kaen Nakhon, decked out in Japanese, minimalist, and art-gallery styles. They're good for shooting content and then sitting back with a coffee.

items.name: 11AM Cafe & Space
items.blurb: A bright white-building cafe in town, decked out in a minimalist style that photographs well from every angle. The signature is a fresh-milk cake with a new flavor every month. Beyond being a cafe, it also has a work-friendly zone, and the location is easy to reach in town — good for anyone who wants both nice photos and real seating.
items.meta: In town, near KKU · Co-working zone · Fresh-milk cake

items.name: Engmore KKC
items.blurb: A Japanese-style cafe behind KKU on the Sila side, with a shady, quiet Japanese garden. It's a favorite for people who shoot Japanese-style photos. The hours are short — 10:00–17:00 — and focused on the daytime atmosphere. Prices start around 120 THB, higher than student spots because it's selling the atmosphere and the decor.
items.meta: Behind KKU, Sila side · Open 10:00–17:00 · From ฿120

items.name: Tempris Cafe
items.blurb: A cafe across from Wat Nong Waeng. The highlight is the second floor, where you can frame a full shot with Phra Mahathat Kaen Nakhon, the city's landmark, in the background — an angle you can only get at this spot. It's an easy stop after visiting Wat Nong Waeng, and the atmosphere works well for content in the evening when the light is nice.
items.meta: Across from Wat Nong Waeng · Phra Mahathat Kaen Nakhon view

items.name: Moooo Milk Bar
items.blurb: A loft-style cafe by Nong Waeng lake, with a seating zone that looks out over the water. It stays open until midnight and has a food menu too, so it's good for sitting back from evening into the night and shooting water views. Prices start around 50 THB, and there are outlets for working late if you want a change of scenery from Kangsadan.
items.meta: By Nong Waeng lake · Open 12:00–24:00 · From ฿50

items.name: Khontemporary Coffee Bar
items.blurb: A loft cafe blended with an art gallery in the Colombo area, with raw exposed concrete walls and rotating art exhibitions to look at. It has a cool industrial feel, with prices starting around 50 THB. Good for art lovers who want a cafe with more to look at than just the coffee — you'll get photo angles that are different from the usual minimalist cafe.

blocks.title: Straight talk
blocks.html: Photo-focused spots like Engmore KKC cost noticeably more than student cafes because they're mainly selling the atmosphere and the decor. If your goal is a long, cheap work session, the Kangsadan group is clearly better value. And several of the photo cafes only open during the day — check the hours before you go so you don't show up to a closed door.

blocks.text: How to Pick a Cafe That Fits What You're Doing

items: Long work sessions with outlets → Caffeingest or inch & ounce in Kangsadan, where you can sit all day without feeling cramped
Serious about coffee → GOODBEANS Roastery roasts its own beans for a good cup in the same area
Want to sit late → Loading Matcha or Moooo Milk Bar, both open until midnight
Shooting content → 11AM Cafe in town, or Tempris where you can frame Phra Mahathat Kaen Nakhon in the shot
Student budget → JuneKo.house on campus, starting at just 45 THB, with room for groups

faq.q: Which Khon Kaen cafes are good for working, with outlets and WiFi?
faq.a: Caffeingest and inch & ounce in Kangsadan behind KKU are genuinely good for long work sessions, with outlets spread throughout and free WiFi, and a quiet enough vibe to focus. Sri Brown Cafe has plenty of seating and handles groups well.

faq.q: Which area are the cafes near Khon Kaen University in?
faq.a: Most are in the Kangsadan area behind the university, a few minutes' walk or drive from campus — for example Caffeingest, Sri Brown, GOODBEANS, and Loading Matcha. JuneKo.house is right inside the university grounds.

faq.q: How much do Khon Kaen cafes cost?
faq.a: Student-focused spots in Kangsadan start around 45–90 THB a cup, which is easy on the wallet. Photo-focused or specialty spots like Engmore KKC and GOODBEANS start around 90–120 THB and up, since they're selling the atmosphere and bean quality.

faq.q: Which Khon Kaen cafes are most photogenic?
faq.a: 11AM Cafe is a minimalist white building that photographs well from every angle, Engmore KKC has a Japanese-style garden, and Tempris lets you frame Phra Mahathat Kaen Nakhon in full from the second floor. Khontemporary is a cafe blended with an art gallery, giving you angles that are different from the usual spots.

faq.q: Which Khon Kaen cafes are open late?
faq.a: Loading Matcha is open until midnight, and Moooo Milk Bar by Nong Waeng lake is also open until midnight — both good for late-night working or just relaxing. Caffeingest and Sri Brown stay open until 21:00.
